description: Mobile recharge (top-up, recarga, recharge, شحن رصيد, रिचार्ज, load): detects the operator of a mobile number and returns the live recharge and top-up options for it (airtime, data packs and plans): what the recipient receives, validity where it applies, and the price in USD. Works for numbers in 100+ countries, for example Jio, Airtel and Vi in India, Telcel, Bait and AT&T in Mexico, Vodafone, Orange and Etisalat in Egypt, Maroc Telecom and inwi in Morocco, Mobilis in Algeria, Jazz and Zong in Pakistan, MTN, Claro, Tigo, Globe and Smart. The number must include the country code, e.g. +911234567890.
